# Open Sesame artwork

`open-sesame-logo.png` is the exact gold emblem on a charcoal tile supplied by the application owner on November 8, 2026 for use as Open Sesame’s app logo. Preserve the original artwork and alpha channel. The native build derives standard icon sizes from this file with the macOS image tools; it does not redraw or crop the mark. The web logo, sign-in mark, favicon, Finder icon and menu-bar icon use this same artwork.

Provider marks and their separate provenance remain in `plugins/README.md`.
